account: Today has seemed mostly routine from what I have personally learned. I attended the plaza market walk at ten and bought a loaf for one emerald. Several townsfolk reported that the baker had been carrying wheat at the bakery and later a sack of bread at the inn. That may simply be baking supplies followed by a bread delivery; I have no evidence of a shortage or wrongdoing. I heard the baker speaking and shouting in the distance around 10:56, but could not make out the words, so I do not know what that was about. The secretary reported no correspondence or town news this morning and took the appointment book to keep it safe and updated. My tea appointment initially lacked an exact address; the neighbour has now personally confirmed three o'clock at the east-bank cottage at (16, -60, 105), near the ferry landing. That was an ordinary clarification, not evidence of anything unusual. I returned home for the noon interval and have now reached the office at 13:09 for town accounts. I have not yet examined the accounts or treasury today. My remaining appointments are tea at fifteen hundred, office at sixteen thirty, and home at nineteen hundred.
